hero.headline: Building in the Upstate.
hero.sub: Go Vertical is a ground-up residential developer in Upstate South Carolina. The work is acquire, entitle, build, and sell. Capital is structured around each project so a private lender or accredited equity partner can plug in at the right level. Active work sits in Greenville and Greer. Nothing on this page is an offer to sell securities.

items.title: Acquire, entitle, build, sell
items.text: Each project is a real entitled deal with a senior construction lender already in the stack. Go Vertical takes ground-up residential from land through retail sale. Partners enter at the level that matches the deal, not a generic fund pitch.

items.title: Private lending
items.text: Short-term private lending is secured by real property on the project. Terms are negotiated directly per deal and are not offered publicly. Per-state lender licensing rules apply. IRA-friendly through self-directed custodians.

items.title: Accredited equity
items.text: Longer-dated equity runs through Go Vertical Fund I, a Regulation D, Rule 506(c) debt fund. Accredited investor verification is required prior to subscription. Documentation and reporting move through the InvestNext portal.

story.heading: Active projects in the Upstate
paragraphs: Jones Street House is ground-up single-family in Greenville's West End: 1,850 SF, 3BD/3BA plus office, walking distance from the Reedy River and downtown. Packs Mountain House is a luxury hillside spec in Taylors with foundation walls underway. Hall Street Cottages are nine detached for-sale cottages along the Reedy River corridor, steps from the Swamp Rabbit Trail and Cleveland Park.

Reidville Luxury Subdivision is a 9+ acre parcel near Reidville: an existing home plus six 0.8+ acre custom lots. Taylors Apartments is a 56-unit, fully entitled ground-up multifamily designed for workforce housing. Development plans on the later deals are complete, with PSA and capital being finalized. Talk about a specific project before committing capital.

items.title: Start with an entitled deal
items.text: Partners review a live project, not a teaser deck. Senior construction lending is already committed on the active houses. You choose the project first, then the capital layer.

items.title: Private lending against the property
items.text: Private lenders use standard mortgage documents with a recorded deed of trust against the project property. The loan sits on a specific house or subdivision, not a blind pool.

items.title: Equity through Reg D Fund I
items.text: Accredited equity partners subscribe to Fund I after verification. Go Vertical and Go Vertical Fund I are not registered investment advisers. Investing involves risk, including the potential loss of principal.

feature.heading: Ground-up residential, project by project
feature.text: The model is simple on purpose. Acquire the land, entitle the plan, build the house or the cottages or the apartments, then sell. Capital is invited onto a named deal so the partner can see the dirt, the drawings, and the senior lender before writing a check.

spotlight.heading: Not an offer to sell securities
spotlight.text: Nothing here constitutes an offer to sell or a solicitation of an offer to buy any security. Fund I is offered only to verified accredited investors pursuant to Rule 506(c) of Regulation D. Past performance is not indicative of future results.
